name: Mencap
description: A UK learning-disability charity providing advice, Easy Read information, a helpline, community routes and a range of support services.
intended_use: Find learning-disability information, accessible advice and routes to Mencap support or services in the UK.
audience_or_context: People with a learning disability, families, carers, professionals and others looking for UK-focused information or support.
limitations: Specific services and local availability vary, so current eligibility and location details need to be checked with Mencap.
The resource is not a substitute for emergency, safeguarding, legal or clinical services when those are needed.
cost_or_access_notes: Much of the advice content is publicly accessible and Mencap advertises a free Learning Disability Helpline; individual support services can have separate eligibility or funding arrangements.
conflicts_of_interest: The organisation's own site is used to record its service scope and access routes; that does not independently establish outcomes or suitability.

provenance.method: Mencap official advice and support surfaces checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records current identity, accessibility routes and service boundaries without adding efficacy claims.
